description: PULP apb_i2c level interrupt with the device's two-write acknowledge protocol. Trigger: CTRL=core_en|ien, TX=0x5a, CMD=0x10 starts the byte transfer; irq_flag is STATUS[0]. Clear (declared by the scenario's ordered irq_clear_sequence, because this increment's executor owns the sequence and the behavior schema's host capability is still one step): third_party/soc-pulp-apb-i2c/apb_i2c.sv:128 `wire iack = r_cmd[0];` is the held register bit and apb_i2c.sv:189-193 `irq_flag <= (s_done | i2c_al | irq_flag) & ~iack;` clears the flag on the first write (CMD=1), after which interrupt_o = irq_flag && s_ien drops; the second write CMD=0 releases the held iack so the peripheral is not left masking every later s_done.
